title: Pseudo-Labels as Rewards, Not Targets: Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Semi-Supervised ASR
abstract: arXiv:2610.32572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adapting ASR to a domain with only untranscribed audio typically relies on pseudo-labeling, a strong teacher transcribes the audio and a student is fine-tuned on it. Because supervised fine-tuning (SFT) treats every pseudo-label token as a target, the student inherits the teacher's errors. We show that using the same pseudo-labels as a reward reference for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is more robust to label noise. In the banking domain, GRPO yields 29.3% to 56.2% relative WER improvements over SFT on Whisper-generated labels, and the advantage holds across four Whisper sizes, four teacher families, three domains and four languages. While SFT reproduces almost 100% of teacher errors verbatim, GRPO passes through only 27%. Rollout statistics explain why, erroneous pseudo-label words rarely appear in on-policy rollouts, so group-relative advantages stay aligned with the clean transcript, whereas SFT forces them into the policy

translated_title: 伪标签作为奖励而非目标：面向半监督自动语音识别的组相对策略优化
translated_abstract: 将自动语音识别（ASR）适配到仅有未转录音频的领域，通常依赖伪标签方法：由一个强大的教师模型转录音频，再用这些转录结果对学生模型进行微调。由于监督微调（SFT）将每个伪标签词元都视为学习目标，学生模型会继承教师模型的错误。我们证明，将相同的伪标签作为组相对策略优化（GRPO）的奖励参考，对标签噪声具有更强的鲁棒性。在银行领域，基于Whisper生成的标签，GRPO相比SFT在词错误率（WER）上取得29.3%至56.2%的相对改进，且该优势在四种Whisper模型规模、四个教师模型家族、三个领域和四种语言上均成立。SFT几乎原封不动地复现了100%的教师错误，而GRPO仅传递了27%。在线策略采样的统计数据解释了其中的原因：错误的伪标签词很少出现在采样结果中，因此组相对优势始终与干净的真实转录保持一致，而SFT则会将这些错误强行纳入模型策略之中。
tldr: 该论文提出将伪标签用作GRPO的奖励参考而非监督微调的目标，使教师错误传递率从100%降至27%，并在四个模型规模、四个教师家族、三个领域和四种语言上取得29.3%-56.2%的相对WER改进，显著提升了半监督ASR对标签噪声的鲁棒性。
